summary: Sibanye-Stillwater filed a Form 6-K furnishing its quarterly operating update for the three months ended 30 September 2026, a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure equivalent to a US current report on operations. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. Reported metrics include group adjusted EBITDA up 9% year-on-year to R10.8 billion (US$662 million), quarter-on-quarter gains at SA PGM and SA gold, steady Century zinc retreatment, and US PGM output curtailed by industrial action. Shares in issue total 2,830,567,264, free float 100%, with an A2X secondary listing effective 6 October 2026. Watch US PGM strike resolution and guidance risk.
